scientific_integrity: The general perfect-Bell interval allocation and fixed-probability scaling are credited to Kim and Popovski; this work evaluates the randomly paired four-user case and analyzes its contention and near-perfect-link scaling. Analytic proofs are distinguished from finite enumeration. Prior equivalence outside inspected records remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Only a single activation slot, a simple path, one independent ideal Bell opportunity per edge, two uniformly paired endpoint-disjoint sessions, perfect output fidelity, and ideal adaptive local processing are analyzed; no device-level or multislotted rate bound is established.
title: Four-user quantum-network contention and the near-perfect-link crossover
